mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.org_id, w.name, w.slug, w.timezone, w.identity_version AS identityVersion, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'active' AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' ORDER BY w.id

SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.timezone, w.identity_version AS identityVersion, wm.role, w.org_id AS orgId, o.name AS orgName, o.identity_version AS orgIdentityVersion, om.org_role AS orgRole FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id JOIN organization o ON o.id = w.org_id LEFT JOIN org_member om ON om.org_id = w.org_id AND om.user_id = wm.user_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'active' AND w.lifecycle_state = 'active' AND o.lifecycle_state = 'active' ORDER BY w.name, w.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.profile_picture_url AS profilePictureUrl, COALESCE(wr.name, wm.role) AS role, wm.role AS builtInRole, wm.role_id AS roleId, wm.status AS status FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN workspace_role wr ON wr.id = wm.role_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(wm.role, 'owner', 'admin', 'member'), u.display_name, u.id
